gpu_tip: ~17GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: smaller than the K-quants at the same bit width and imatrix-calibrated, at the cost of more CPU work per token for any layer that spills. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 16GB DDR5 kit covers it; I-quants run best on CUDA/ROCm.
mac_tip: Needs ~17GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro (M4, M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro) comfortably; a 16GB config needs the KV cache knob's q4_0 option.
